newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 edges higher led by Komercni Banka.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 edges higher led by Komercni Banka.

text.p: The Czech PX50 edged higher on Tuesday as major issues, especially Komercni Banka, recovered from losses at the morning fixing.
The PX50 rose 0.3 percent to 558.2 while the RPIX index of continuously traded shares gained 0.44 percent to 1,166.5.
Komercni Banka which dropped back on Monday and fell at the fixing bounced back to close 30 crowns higher to 2,400.
Dealers said that it was increasingly difficult to sell Komercni shares at lower prices as the market was expecting an influx of foreign buying, especially in the blue chips.
Speaking directly about Komercni, Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings said:
"People are still waiting for money to come in. People expect increases in prices and don't want to sell too low."
Other major issues also rose from the fixing. SPT Telecom, which was down 20 crowns closed 10 lower to 3,390. CEZ, which was unchanged at the fixing moved five crowns higher to 1,075.
Activity was lower with volume at 694,994 shares and turnover at 591 million crowns.
